images.content: Ph.J. van Borssele van der Hooghe (London) to Heinsius, 3 Apr 1714 -- clear Dutch text; editorial footnote states a cipher letter is added on the same leaf, plus a separate decipherment ('oplossing') possibly of the same item

note: The printed edition text of letter 959 itself is in clear Dutch; the cipher and the possible decipherment it refers to are on the manuscript leaf only (H.A. 1836), not printed here or imaged this pass.
